answer: Agents predict canyon trail closures after storms. Each bonded forecast lists timber crossings and is sealed before a ranger signs the outcome log with a quill. A fixed reward pool is divided by distinct prediction vectors; ten aliases posting the same vector split one share. To earn more, an attacker must fund different forecasts and bear losses when wrong. Small edits can evade exact matching, so near-identical vectors are grouped and funding sources audited. Coordinated accounts with truly independent predictions remain a limit.
